release_v0054: Complete CI failed the old timing-based preparation test; signing and production were skipped. Original failure retained in the upstream signing bundle.
disk_floor: Local release build guard refused to start while system free disk was below 10 GiB. After active test processes ended, space recovered above the floor; no user apps/data/history were removed.

first_protected_wrapper.diagnosis: Driver omitted CFFIXED_USER_HOME. ModelStorage.defaultRoot resolved into the real Utter Application Support path denied by the privacy policy. Preparation precedes the injected dependency. This diagnosis follows environment, policy and source; the log did not print the underlying mkdir errno.

second_protected_wrapper.diagnosis: Correct isolated user directory required an uncached SwiftPM manifest. Native nested sandbox_apply was refused before tests.

resolution: Compile the same isolated-home manifest and tests outside the private runtime policy with native SwiftPM sandboxing preserved. Run protected swift test --skip-build using that same CFFIXED_USER_HOME. Full execution then passed without product code changes or a weakened policy.
